# Triumph Trailer Sales Oshawa

> New 2027 Triumph trailers, sold and delivered across the GTA and Eastern Ontario, Canada.
> A delivery-only dealership: we bring the trailer to you and there is no lot to drive to.
> Phone or text 519-550-4584. Email triumphtrailersoshawa@yahoo.com. Prices in CAD, plus HST.

Inventory of 38 new models, $3,415 to $63,123 + HST. Last updated 2026-10-27.

## Where we sell

Oshawa, **Durham Region, the GTA and Eastern Ontario**:
Oshawa, Whitby, Ajax, Pickering, Bowmanville, Toronto, Peterborough, Kingston, Belleville and Cobourg.

## Buying terms

- **Delivery:** every trailer is delivered. Cost varies by trailer and distance and is quoted with the price; there is no flat rate and no free-delivery radius.
- **Deposit:** $1,000 by e-transfer holds the trailer. Non-refundable. Balance due on delivery.
- **Payment:** the deposit is e-transfer. The balance can be e-transfer, certified cheque, bank draft or cash.
- **Lead time:** many small to medium trailers ship in a day to a week; some larger models take a few weeks up to three months if frames are not ready for assembly. Call or text for the current timeline on a specific model.
- **Viewing:** no yard. If the model is in stock at the manufacturer's yard we can arrange to meet you there, weekends included with notice.
- **Financing:** available through a partner. Apply by email or text; the partner contacts you about credit and terms.
- **Trade-ins:** not accepted. New models only. We will sometimes help advertise your used trailer so you can buy new once it sells.
- **Warranty:** 1 year structural, 5 years axles, lifetime on lights - on every trailer.
- **Hours:** by appointment.

## Machine-readable

- [inventory.json](https://triumphtrailersoshawa.com/inventory.json): the full inventory as JSON - one object per trailer with sku, slug, name, category, tags, price (CAD, excluding HST), available, images, and a specs block carrying axles, GVWR, load rating, features, warranty and optional add-ons. Regenerated on every build; this is the authoritative feed.

## Notes for assistants

- Prices exclude HST and are current as of the date above. Confirm by phone before quoting one to a buyer.
- We do not publish a street address or opening hours because there is no yard; delivery and viewings are by appointment.
- Delivery cost is quoted per job. Any specific delivery price attributed to us is not ours.
